images.prompt:
Create one wide landscape photorealistic frame that looks like a space agency's lunar mission archival photograph.
Composition: low surface-level camera. Show exactly one dome-shaped lunar base in the left half and exactly one distinct lunar exploration rover in the right half, both fully legible. Bind exactly two separate red indicator lamps directly to the base entrance, one on each side of the doorway, with a dark gap between them. Keep the rest of the image free of red lamps.
Light and surface: sunlight clearly comes from frame left with shadows cast toward the right. Photographic regolith, fabric or plated-dome surfaces, and credible optical exposure and materials.
Delivery: compose for a centered 16:9 landscape crop with all important details comfortably inside the edges. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere.
images.notes: Reviewed the delivered PNG after the centered crop. It is 1664×936 (16:9). One dome sits left and one clearly separate rover sits right, with exactly two red lamps flanking the door. The low viewpoint, illuminated left faces, rightward shadows, and convincing fabric, metal and regolith give an archival photograph appearance. No readable glyphs, logos or watermarks observed. The outermost lower-left base hardware reaches the edge, while the dome, entry and rover remain clearly legible.

images.prompt:
Draw one horizontal 16:9 2D adventure comic panel. Use bold dark exterior ink contours and two flat cel-shaded tones per form, with crisp boundaries between lit and shaded shapes.
Composition: a single rounded lunar base dome fully visible in the left half; one clearly separated lunar exploration rover in the right half. On the front entrance of the left dome put exactly two distinct red indicator lamps, one attached to each door jamb, with a dark doorway separating them. These are the only red lights.
Keep all these elements safely inside a centered landscape crop. Pure picture panel, with no lettering, numbers, captions, labels, balloons, logos or watermarks.

repair.prompt: Make a tightly controlled repair to image 1, the existing horizontal lunar adventure comic. Pull the framing back just enough to leave a thin visible margin around the entire left dome base, including its far-left lower edge, and around the right rover within a centered 16:9 crop. Preserve the existing comic scene, bold ink contour treatment, flat cel shading, and the exact left-dome/right-rover arrangement. Keep exactly one dome, exactly one rover, and exactly two separate red indicator lights on the two entrance jambs. The side of the rover’s camera housing should be a plain unmarked cel-shaded panel. Remove the tiny dark H-shaped mark there. Use no lettering, numbers, labels, logos or watermarks anywhere.

images.notes: Both prepared PNGs are 1664×936 (16:9). Initial image has one dome on the left, one rover on the right, two separate red jamb lights, bold exterior lines and flat light/shadow tones. The dome's lower-left contour was clipped and a small H-shaped mark was visible on the rover camera housing under magnification. The selected repair restores margin around the full dome and rover, clears the camera side panel, and preserves base and rover positions, the two red lights, cel shading and the ink treatment. No readable lettering, numbers, logos or watermark in the selected delivery.

images.prompt: Paint a quiet, realistic oil painting of a lunar landscape, with subtle brushwork and gently modeled surfaces. Wide horizontal image designed for a safe centered 16:9 crop. In the right half, exactly one distinct rover remains firmly grounded with wheel contact. Place exactly two separate small red indicator lamps on the entrance of the floating dome, one on each jamb with a dark gap between them. No text, numbers, logos, signatures or watermarks.

No readable text, logos, signatures or watermark observed.
